instruction: Preserve completed and running work and the selected smaller queue; append higher targets. User subsequently chose conservative 2p4a p12 instead of p18, without a near-14-day forecast, and GPU PACK* for all nine additions.
scope: The ten single-tier systems discussed on October 6; 4z80 is running and unchanged, leaving nine targets.
runtime_interpretation: Exploratory tier choices, not validated forecasts. A constant per-tier multiplier and historical-to-current scaling are sensitivity assumptions. Timeout histories supply lower bounds only. Branchwidth informs PACK* complexity, not a MARK* runtime predictor.

1b6c.reason: Use the only same-CPU adjacent historical growth pair; add two positions rather than extrapolating across different CPU models. Both scaling and persistence of this growth remain unmeasured.

1gwc.reason: Historical p3 exceeded 336 hours on 16 CPUs. p4 adds one position above that timeout tier. No exact near-14-day forecast can be obtained from the timeout lower bound.

2hnu.reason: Six tiers use the observed same-CPU p2-to-p3 multiplier; the six-position extrapolation is uncertain. The scan stays at branchwidth 7 through p11 and rises at p12.

2p4a.reason: User requested a conservative increase. Retain p9 and add three positions to p12. Scan branchwidth rises from 4 to 5, compared with 9 at the withdrawn p18. Neither branchwidth nor the mixed-hardware timing history predicts MARK* runtime. The former p18 assumption of a fourfold core speedup and constant 1.8-fold tier growth was not validated; p18 was only preflighted and never submitted.

2xxm.reason: p1 completed in 6338 seconds. Six further positions target a multi-day workload using exploratory growth; mixed historical CPU models preclude a reliable per-tier fit. p7 has scan branchwidth 8.

3bu8.reason: Use the latest same-CPU p9-to-p10 historical multiplier, applied to the measured current p9. Do not interpret mixed-hardware p10-to-p11 flattening as a same-CPU trend.

3k3q.reason: Only p0 has historical timing. Three added positions are an exploratory choice at 2.5-fold growth per position; no empirical within-system tier slope exists.

4kt6.reason: Use the same-CPU historical p0-to-p1 multiplier with the current measured p1 time. Keep the new task on p1's actual DCC CPU model.

4znc.reason: p6 used an older E5 CPU, so applying only a fourfold CPU-count correction understates hardware changes. Use a 10-fold hardware-plus-core sensitivity and about 1.55 growth from recent same-EPYC adjacent tiers; both assumptions are uncertain over eight tiers.

external_correction.source: User correction; supersedes the earlier not-started reply
